translations.web: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.
translations.bsb: And today the LORD has proclaimed that you are His people and treasured possession as He promised, that you are to keep all His commandments,
translations.kjv: And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;
translations.asv: and Jehovah hath avouched thee this day to be a people for his own possession, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;
